_comment: Main Phase 1 sweep: FIFO, fixed K, at the base server config. Rates set from the pilot (mean service time ~16.6 s for this mix at K=1, i.e. ~0.06 tasks/s capacity): 0.05 is light load, 0.1 and 0.2 overload K=1 by ~1.7x and ~3.3x. Dev seeds only (0-99); seeds 1000+ are reserved for Phase 2 evaluation. --cache-ram 0 disables llama.cpp's host-RAM prompt cache, so server memory equals the fixed budget (model + KV + compute); the cache is studied separately in sweep_cache.json.
